name: The Lantern Roads
attribution: Original demonstration content created for Character Folio. This is homebrew sample data, not an official D&D class or spell collection.
coverageNotes: Levels 1–5; single class; standard array; fixed-average HP.
Original demonstration content using the 2024 builder conventions. Spell effects and combat are narrative examples, not a balanced published ruleset.
Inventory, equipment purchasing, combat, multiclassing, and cantrip replacement are outside this MVP.

species.name: Roadfolk
species.text: People of the old lantern roads. You can always recall the path of a journey you have walked yourself.

species.name: Mosskin
species.text: Small, patient folk whose moss-soft skin carries the scent of rain. Their compact frames are unusually resilient.

backgrounds.name: Archive Runner
backgrounds.text: You carried fragile records between distant reading rooms. One undelivered letter still waits in your satchel.
backgrounds.equipment: A journal, ink, a weatherproof satchel, and a sealed letter. Inventory is a narrative note in this demo.

backgrounds.name: Night Guide
backgrounds.text: You guided strangers home by lamplight. You remember faces better than destinations.
backgrounds.equipment: A lantern, a worn map, and traveler’s clothes. Inventory is a narrative note in this demo.

feats.name: Patient Reader
feats.text: Your patient study grants proficiency in Arcana.

feats.name: Weathered
feats.text: Your journeys grant 1 additional maximum HP for each character level.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.text: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1, to a maximum of 20.

feats.name: Steady Flame
feats.text: Increase Constitution or Charisma by 1. Your calm preparation grants proficiency in Insight.

spells.name: Ember Script
spells.text: Trace a brief, harmless message in the air with warm sparks. It fades when you finish reading it aloud.

spells.name: Little Beacon
spells.text: A small floating light follows your hand. It illuminates a forgotten corner without giving off heat.

spells.name: Paper Bird
spells.text: Fold a scrap of paper into a bird that glides to a creature you can see, carrying a written message.

spells.name: Quiet Thread
spells.text: Tie a faint thread of light around an object so you can recognize it by touch.

spells.name: Sheltering Glow
spells.text: Create a pocket of warm light around a willing companion. Its exact protection is adjudicated by your GM in this demonstration setting.

spells.name: Borrowed Dawn
spells.text: Fill a small space with the light and birdsong of a remembered morning.

spells.name: Trail Whisper
spells.text: Ask the wind to repeat the last ordinary sound heard along a nearby path.

spells.name: Lantern Bridge
spells.text: Describe a bridge of lantern light spanning a modest gap; agree on its limits with your GM.

spells.name: Echo Room
spells.text: Let companions see an impression of a room as you remember it.

spells.name: Keeper’s Call
spells.text: Your lantern briefly shows the direction of a fellow keeper who welcomes the connection.

spells.name: Keeper’s Circle
spells.text: Light a ring of welcoming lamps around your campsite.

classes.name: Lantern Keeper
classes.summary: Carry a little light into places the world has forgotten.
classes.equipment: A walking staff and a lantern. This demo records equipment as notes; it does not calculate purchases or armor.

features.name: The lantern
features.text: Your lantern is a personal keepsake and the focus of your magic.

features.name: Lantern magic
features.text: Choose your cantrips and known spells. This example class uses a shared pool of spell slots that refreshes after a rest.

features.name: A calling
features.text: Choose which part of the lantern road you will care for.

features.name: Two lights
features.text: Your story now reaches beyond a single road. Record a place you promise to return to.

talents.name: Listener
talents.text: Learn to notice the words people leave unsaid. Gain proficiency in Insight.

talents.name: Letter Keeper
talents.text: You keep careful records. Gain proficiency in History.

talents.name: Path Reader
talents.text: You understand the traces left by travelers. Gain proficiency in Survival.

talents.name: Gentle Hand
talents.text: Your steady care grants proficiency in Medicine.

subclasses.name: Waylight
subclasses.text: You lead the lost toward a place they can call home.

features.name: A light in the window
features.text: A small lamp becomes your sign of welcome. Describe a place where a friend leaves one burning for you.

subclasses.name: Memory Keeper
subclasses.text: You preserve the stories carried by abandoned places.

features.name: The remembered road
features.text: Keep a short memory of every meaningful place you visit.
